design.authorization: 2026-10-22 사용자: benign 제외, 2개부터 사례 수를 늘려 수렴을 단일 seed로 탐색한 후 다른 seed로 검증
design.balanced_cap: Minimum full-clean-train attack-class count; CIC web_attacks=450, ToN ransomware=2151; no duplication or unequal class caps
design.sampling: Keep each EXP86 seed's first 20 rows per attack, append uniformly sampled rows without replacement from the remaining same-class train pool; nested and paired between models
design.models: Unchanged XGB300/depth8/lr.05/subsample.8/colsample.8/min_child_weight1 and frozen TabPFN-v3/4 estimators/fit_with_cache/CPU cache/no subsampling
design.evaluation: Only the original fixed attack test rows; CIC390270 and ToN797421; no benign train or inference; no FT
design.query_order: Filter the original seed43 mixed query order down to attack rows; batch8192; rerun pilot 2/5/10/20 to use the same attack-only execution protocol at every n
design.anchor: At n20 compare attack-only predictions against saved EXP86 attack predictions; report batch-composition sensitivity if any

plateau.pilot: Both models have max-min F1 <=1 percentage point over last3 budgets; require that condition at two consecutive budgets, including one larger confirmation budget
plateau.validation: Run seeds44-47 at the last3 pilot budgets; reuse seed43. Check each model's five-seed mean range <=1pp, disclose per-seed ranges and paired gaps. If mean plateau fails, evaluate the next grid budget at all5 seeds and check the latest3 again, until confirmed or available-label cap
plateau.cap: If the available-label cap is reached, say label cap reached; never label it converged merely because execution ends
plateau.between_model_gap: Report |PFN-XGB|<=1pp separately; descriptive closeness is not statistical equivalence

design.selection_caveat: Exploratory learning curves on an already-inspected fixed test; extra seeds verify sampling/model variability, not an untouched test or external generalization
design.cost: Fresh construct+fit/cache preparation and attack-test inference separately; not sequential update
design.feature_disjoint: No changing feature-disjoint test used for stopping or main curves; exact overlap counts may be recorded as diagnostics
design.report: Automatically regenerate Korean standalone LaTeX, figures, CSVs and log; temporary PDF compile; retain predictions, IDs, code and decisions

extension_plan.reason: Balanced learning curves reached the rarest-class pool size before a clear plateau
extension_plan.sampling: Keep all nested existing rows; sample additional distinct train rows; per-class min(target_n, available_class_rows); same fixed attack test and matched models
